Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before changing this repository.

Work only on a feature branch. Never edit, commit or push directly on main/master,
bypass hooks, force-push or merge a PR. Run `sh scripts/setup-dev.sh` in a new clone,
then preserve staged/unstaged work and run the full pre-push checks before pushing.
Do not change physical lights, running services, NAS or private configuration as
part of repository maintenance.
